Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner fabricated/used incorrect coordinates for Ampelakia, Evros (claiming 41.5000 N, 26.3990 E) and misapplied a border heuristic to place it in Turkey, directly contradicting the just-cited sources (e.g., Wikipedia) stating Ampelakia, Evros is in Greece.
